test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 30th November 2021 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 4.**
solution:
The correct answer is "**earlier**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In the given sentence, we need to use the **comparative adjective** of the adjective **"early".**
 
• We need to use the **comparative adjective** as the speaker is comparing the size of the crowd before and during the final ceremony.
 
• The comparative adjective form of early is "**earlier**".

Hence, the correct answer is** option 3.**

The complete passage is: Football legend Diego Maradona was buried in a private ceremony after a day of *(1) emotional* scenes in the Argentine capital Buenos Aires. Only* (2) around* two dozen relatives and close friends and *(3) attended* the final ceremony on Thursday. But *(4) earlier *huge crowds turned out to pay (5) their respects, with many weeping, blowing kisses, and praying as they filed past his coffin.
